author: keenanjt
body:
As you have probably noticed, I have added the much requested search feature to the forums. You can search by author and discussion content, but there are methods to find precisely what you are looking for.

Usage

  • The author field is self explanatory. Simply type in a user and only discussions created by that user will show up.
  • The search field looks in the title and body content of a discussion. By default, this field matches complete words meaning a search for "Potat" will not find a discussion called "Potato". Use the following operators to maximize the potential of this field, and to find what you are looking for (should be familiar to Google or other search engines).

Operators

Operator Purpose Example Usage
+ Indicates the following word must be present. +apple +juice
- Indicates the following word must not present. apple -macintosh
* Used to match partial words. appl* computers
"  " Find phrases or groups of words. "how to post images"

Examples

Search Result
rules terms Results will contain either "rules" or "terms" (or both).
+"forum game" +rate The results will all contain the term "forum game" (precisely) and the word "rate" in the title or body.
+guide +map Discussions containing both "guide" and "map" will show up.
potat* Discussions containing words that start with "potat" such as "potato" will be shown.
